correctness.rationale: At each vertex of the underlying cubic graph the three incident edge spins form an interaction triangle, every interaction is counted once, and the all-rung-negative/all-rail-positive assignment simultaneously attains each local minimum. The explicit 4x4 transfer matrix enforces both triangle constraints, counts each spin exponent once under cyclic trace, and has a checked factored determinant. Its simple Perron eigenvalue at z=1 yields the radical uniform Curie coefficient by exact implicit differentiation and the explicitly ordered limits. Symbolic transfer checks and independently generated physical spin-bond exhaustive computations for n=3..6 agree; finite checks are only corroboration.
